title: Compute and App Hosting
description: Explore Azure compute options including Virtual Machines, App Service plans, deployment slots, scaling, and how to choose the right hosting model.
longDescription: This module focuses on Azure compute and application hosting services. You will learn how to compare VMs, App Service, Functions, and Container Apps, and how to configure App Service for real-world developer scenarios including deployments, slots, and autoscale.
whatYouLearn: Compare Azure compute services for application hosting
Provision and configure an App Service plan
Deploy web applications using common strategies
Use deployment slots for safer releases
Configure autoscale rules based on metrics and schedules
Choose between App Service, Functions, and Container Apps
